en: Color postcard showing a landscaped city park with patterned flowerbeds, tree-lined paths and people strolling; historic buildings with towers and a modern mid‑century block appear in the background. Reverse side has Romanian printed caption, publisher credit, two Romanian stamps, a 1975 postmark and a German handwritten message addressed to a camping site in Mamaia, Constanța.
